schema.description: An empty body generates a password for you.

Password.description:
The password to set. Must satisfy your organization's password policy, which
governs its length, the kinds of characters it needs and whether it may appear in
a known data breach (by default: at least 30 characters, including a number and a
lowercase letter, not found in a breach), and at most 64 characters. Omit it to have one
generated.
